snippet.title: Sinthetic Chapter 1 Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the dystopia that is Vacancy City. In an open-world, action-RPG featuring a combination of elements from Western and Japanese RPGs. Join the ragtag squad of unlikely allies led by the veteran-turned-mercenary Fawke Harvey as they apprehend crime while they uncover a conspiracy.
